description: Repairs r-sort-3/create-keys-accdb: the NP1..NP8 loads used Database.Execute without options (refusals returned hr 0 with no error number), and NP10's DAO index was never created: TableDefs.Item("NP10") failed with 0x800A0CC1 because the collection was not refreshed after CREATE TABLE, so its 12 inserts ran on a table with no index. Fixture (ACCDB), CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128). NP1..NP10 (K TEXT(20), N Long) as in the original (unique, IGNORE NULL, DISALLOW NULL, primary key, NOT NULL and non-unique variants; NP9 and NP10 get a DAO index on K with Unique and Required, IgnoreNulls True for NP9 and False for NP10), each built with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors after every statement. The DAO route refreshes TableDefs before Item, reads DBEngine.Errors after Indexes.Append and refreshes Indexes. Then 12 INSERTs per table over the tuples (Null,Null) x2, (Null,1) x2, (a,Null) x2, (a,1) x2, (empty,Null) x2, (empty,1) x2, one per statement with DBEngine.Errors after each; then the surviving (K, N) of each table and every index (Name, Primary, Unique, Foreign, Required, IgnoreNulls, DistinctCount, fields).
